title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Platform
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Platform. A Platform is an entity that hosts other entities, particularly Sensors, Actuators, Samplers, and other Platforms (definition taken from sosa:Platform). Subclass of sosa:Platform (W3C SOSA, not modeled here). See the ex:ArvalisLand07 platform example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2, Figure 9, which hosts the ex:ArvalisIrrinovStation01 system.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Platform'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. A human-readable name for this platform.

location.description: GeoProperty. The physical location of the platform (inherited geospatial convention; not a formally declared sosa:Platform restriction in the ttl).

hosts.description: Relationship. sosa:hosts (inverse: sosa:isHostedBy). 'Relation between a platform and the systems it hosts.' The systems/devices (e.g. a WateringSystem or WeatherStation) hosted by this platform.
